metaDescription: TimeTrack support: contact your company administrator first for attendance and payroll help, or email the TimeTrack support team for technical issues.
title: Support
productLine: TimeTrack — workforce time tracking, scheduling and payroll

sections.heading: Workplace & attendance help
paragraphs: For missed punches, shift corrections, leave and payroll questions, contact your company administrator or branch manager first — they can amend records directly in TimeTrack (every amendment is audited).

sections.heading: In-app FAQ
paragraphs: Signed-in users can open the FAQ from the navigation for setup guides: location permissions, automatic clock-in/out troubleshooting, offline behaviour and notifications.

sections.heading: App-level technical support
paragraphs: For installation problems, bugs, or account-access issues you cannot resolve with your administrator, email the TimeTrack support team. Include your device, app version and a short description.

sections.heading: Privacy & data requests
paragraphs: Privacy policy, POPIA/GDPR rights requests and data-protection contact details are on the [privacy page](/privacy).
